name: True Vitamin
ingredients_raw: Magnesium oxide, Diluent [INS 460001 N-acetyl-L-cysteine, L-ascorbic acid, Bilberry (Vaccinium 9myrstillus-25% Anthocyanidin) fruit extract, Ginkgo biloba-24% Glycosides leaf extract, Korean ginseng (Panax ginseng-10% Ginsenosides) root extract, Grape (Vitis vinifera-95% Proanthocyanidins) seed extract, Pomegranate (Punica granatum - 40% polyphenols) fruit extract, Disintegrants [INS 468 & Sodium starch glycolate], Stabilizer [INS 1202], Natural colour [INS 171] & Synthetic colour [INS 172 (ii), INS 110 & INS 124], Liquorice (Glycyrrhiza glabra - 20% Glycyrrhizin) root extract, Stabilizer [INS1201], Nicotinamide, Ferrous fumarate, dl-alpha-tocopheryl acetate, Zinc oxide, Coating agent [INS 462], Glidant [INS 553 (iii)), Anti-Sticking agent [INS 470 (iii)],Calcium D-Pantothenate, Anti-Caking agent [INS 551]. Manganese sulphate, Pyridoxine hydrochloride, Riboflavin, Cupric sulphate, Thiamine mononitrate, Retinyl acetate, n-pteroyl-l-glutamic acid, Potassium iodide, Chromium trichloride, Sodium selenate, D-Biotin, Ergocalciferol, Cyanocobalamin and Artificial flavours [Peppermint & Vanilla).
